requiredFeatures: A clearly playable circular or hex-radial arena platform with front stairs and an unobstructed central contest floor.
A coherent 360-degree column arcade with open bays; columns support a low crown and never become cage clutter.
Two crossed honey dippers, not block hammers, form the dominant arena emblem and remain readable at phone scale.
Each dipper has a slender handle, ribbed grooved honey head, glossy honey coating, and one restrained hanging drop.
The crossed emblem is physically seated over the challenge dais or front crown support and never floats as a badge.
A compact amber nectar core supports the emblem without becoming a generic crystal centerpiece.
Purple banners are subordinate accents; the roof/crown reads honey-gold rather than as a purple circus gazebo.
Side and rear views preserve open arena bays, supported roof logic, and a visible secondary crossed-dipper silhouette.
strictRejects: block hammers, axes, or generic construction tools
oversized roof ring hiding the contest floor
more than one bounded correction in this construction family

capture.blockoutGate: All structural categories at least 0.75 with no strict reject.
capture.finalGate: All required categories at least 0.85 with no strict reject.
